item.title: On-demand instantaneous bandwidth microwave receiver via scalable Rydberg Vapor cell array with Stark comb
Certifying the Rydberg-exposure limit of a globally driven controlled-Z gate
item.description: arXiv:2611.07388v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Rydberg excitation enables entangling gates in neutral-atom quantum processors but also exposes them to spontaneous decay. Whether this exposure can be made arbitrarily small through pulse shaping and longer gate times has remained unresolved. We show that an exact controlled-$Z$ gate driven by a single global laser has an irreducible Rydberg-exposure cost in the perfect-blockade regime.
